1. All attempted suspicious transactions must be reported, regardless of the amount involved.
2. The relevant regulatory basis is found in Section 522 from [Source 1: 2019.03-Guidance-Guidance-Note-4B-STRs.txt].
3. According to this section, there should be no monetary threshold for reporting suspicious or unusual transactions if they give rise to a suspicion of unlawful activities like money laundering or terror financing; the mere fact that something is suspected under these circumstances mandates reporting without consideration of transaction amounts involved in isolation.
